effect: Sound test (after the next valid password)
note: Already known. $C959 compares the 8 letters with $C96F; a match sets $3451 = $FF and then runs the normal decoder, which rejects it (O, M, S, U, N, D are not in their rows). The next valid code, any one, sees $3451 = $FF at $C76B and jumps to the sound test $C59E instead of starting the game. Typed BOMSOUND then MUVWLNPC in Mesen, US and JP: SOUND-00 screen; Bomberman Collection: opens the sound test too (docs/pcevc.md)

code: Hi score hundreds digit 3, demo not cut, hold Down+Select+I+II, Run on 1P START, keep holding through the intro
effect: Special Select Room: scene, stage, bombs 1-10, fire 1-15 and four power-up toggles
note: $01:A001 (called at $00:EAEC after the intro) needs: Down+Run+Select+II+I all held ($2200 & $4F = $4F), $10 != 0 (the last attract demo ran to its end, $0B:CDBE; Run during it clears $10) and $2001 = 3, the hundreds digit of the high score, exactly. In Mesen (US): 300 and 1300 open it, 200 and 400 do not, a demo cut short with Run does not; no reset is needed (high score set at power-on works); JP same code and result for 300/400; Bomberman Collection: opens the same way (docs/pcevc.md)

effect: Invincible: fire and enemies never kill (US, Bomberman Collection)

A random-input bot over 6,000 frames: 0 deaths with the cheat, 6 deaths and a game over without; same on the Collection. The timer running out still kills.
